name: Motion primitives (measured)
description: Pure functions of time measured from reference videos: spring, letterRise, wordRise, cardSlide, stamp, wordSlam, morph, relaxTo, dissolveOut, press, cursorSquish, typing, sweepChar, beatPulse, barFill, clickWipe, bigSettle, keynoteCam, rise, outAt.

name: Stage + TimeProvider + Sequence
description: Fixed-pixel video frame for 16:9, 9:16, 4:5, 3:4, 1:1 with safe-area guides; frame-time context (useTime); Sequence shows children between two times and fades them out.

name: LetterRise headline
description: Headline letters spring up one by one (ClimbX measured), accent words in the accent colour.
props: text, t0, size, color, accent[], accentColor

name: Stamp
description: Pill, badge, price or logo slams in with overshoot and tilt (ClimbX).

name: CardSlide
description: Floating white UI card slides in from the right with motion blur.

name: Typer
description: Typing at ~30 chars/s; newest letter born in the accent colour; solid caret.

name: PressButton
description: Button that presses (0.954 then spring) at a given time.

name: Cursor
description: Mouse pointer moving through timed keyframes, squishing on clicks, optional fade-out. Park it on a button's edge, never over CTA text.

name: CountBar
description: Big number counting up with a filling bar (ClimbX bar fill).

name: Strike
description: Red line draws through a row (it's not X, it's Y).

name: Rise
description: Generic opacity + blur + 40px rise-in with optional fade-out time.

name: Captions (karaoke)
description: Full captions from word timings [[word,start,end]] (ElevenLabs Scribe/TTS alignment). 2–4 word phrases, active word in accent, optional dark box.
props: words, y, max, size, accent, boxed

name: EndCard
description: Dark end card: wordmark rises, CTA pill stamps in, cursor parks on the pill's edge and fades.
props: t0, wordmark, sub, cta, w, h, accent

name: useGsapTimeline
description: Build a paused GSAP timeline once and seek it to the frame time every render. Registers SplitText, DrawSVG, MorphSVG, Text, ScrambleText, MotionPath, Flip, CustomEase.

name: Showcase composition
description: Example video using every core component (12 s). Copy as a starting template.

name: GSAP demo composition
description: Example GSAP timeline (SplitText chars, DrawSVG underline, staggered chips) seeked per frame.

name: Kokonut demo composition
description: Kokonut Background Paths + AI Text Loading used as is, rendered in clock mode.
